title: Utility Rate Plan Payment Overdue Alert
dataSources: Utility bills (`utility:bill`), utility meter readings (`utility:meter`), utility rate changes (`utility:rate`), household accounts (`household:account`), utility payments (`utility:payment`).
app: Electric, gas, and water bills, smart-meter readings, household-account records, and utility rate-plan changes streamed to Splunk HEC via portals, CSV exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=utility:rate
| eval days_overdue=round((now()-due_epoch)/86400,1)
| where payment_status!="paid" AND days_overdue>0
| table _time provider estimated_bill_amount days_overdue
| sort - days_overdue
description: Lists unpaid utility rate plan items that are already past due.
value: Late utility payments are one of the easiest household problems to prevent with a small exception queue.
implementation: Map provider payment state into a simple `payment_status` field and populate `due_epoch` from the statement.
visualization: Table of overdue utility payments by provider and overdue age.
grandmaExplanation: It turns which utility rate plan bills are already late and should be handled first.
